whir.definition: n. sound of something in rapid motion
whir.translation:
n. 呼呼声, 飕飕声
vi. 作呼呼声, 发飕飕声
vt. 使呼呼响

whirl.definition:
n. confused movement
n. the shape of something rotating rapidly
v. cause to spin
v. fly around
whirl.translation:
n. 回旋, 旋转, 急走, 眩晕
vt. 使旋转, 使回旋, 卷走
vi. 回旋, 旋转, 急走, 发晕

whirlabout.definition:
n. Something that whirls or turns about in a rapid manner;
   a whirligig.

whirlaway.definition: n thoroughbred that won the triple crown in 1941
whirlaway.translation: n. 急速的旋转, 飞速的发展

whirlblast.translation: n. 旋风,旋流, 飓风

whirlbone.definition:
n. The huckle bone.
n. The patella, or kneepan.

whirled.translation: v. （使）飞快移动, 使旋转( whirl的过去式和过去分词 )

whirler.definition:
n a dervish whose actions include ecstatic dancing and whirling
n a revolving mechanism

whirley.translation: 回转式起重机, 旋臂吊车

whirlicote.definition: n. An open car or chariot.

whirligig.definition: v. whirl or spin like a whirligig
whirligig.translation: n. 旋转玩具, 旋转木马, 循环, 轮回, 变迁

whirligigs.definition:
plural of whirligig
v. whirl or spin like a whirligig
whirligigs.translation: (whirligig 的复数) n. 旋转玩具, 旋转木马, 循环, 轮回, 变迁

whirling.definition:
n the act of rotating in a circle or spiral
v turn in a twisting or spinning motion
v cause to spin
v flow in a circular current, of liquids
v revolve quickly and repeatedly around one's own axis
v fly around
whirling.translation: v. 旋转；眩晕；卷走；疾走（whirl的ing形式）

whirling dervish.translation: [网络] 回旋舞；旋转托僧仪式；旋转舞

whirlings.definition:
plural of whirling
n the act of rotating in a circle or spiral
v turn in a twisting or spinning motion
v cause to spin
v flow in a circular current, of liquids
v revolve quickly and repeatedly around one's own axis
v fly around
whirlings.translation: (whirling 的复数) v. 旋转；眩晕；卷走；疾走（whirl的ing形式）

whirlpool.definition: n. a powerful circular current of water (usually the result of conflicting tides)
whirlpool.translation:
n. 漩涡, 涡流
[化] 涡流

whirlpooled.definition:
past tense of whirlpool
n. a powerful circular current of water (usually the result of conflicting tides)
whirlpooled.translation:
(whirlpool 的过去时) n. 漩涡, 涡流
[化] 涡流

n. a powerful circular current of water (usually the result of conflicting tides)
v. flow in a circular current, of liquids
whirlpools.translation: n. 漩涡( whirlpool的复数形式 )

whirls.definition:

n a usually brief attempt
n the act of rotating rapidly

whirlwind.definition: n. a more or less vertical column of air whirling around itself as it moves over the surface of the Earth

whirlwinds.definition: n. a more or less vertical column of air whirling around itself as it moves over the surface of the Earth
whirlwinds.translation: n. 旋风( whirlwind的复数形式 )

whirly.translation:
a. 回旋的, 旋转的
n. 小旋风

whirlybird.definition: n an aircraft without wings that obtains its lift from the rotation of overhead blades

whirr.definition:
n sound of something in rapid motion
v make a soft swishing sound
v make a vibrant sound, as of some birds
whirr.translation:
vi. 发呼呼声, 作飕飕声, 作呼呼声
vi.vt. 呼呼地飞
n. 呼呼声, 嗡嗡声, 飕飕声, 匆忙, 熙攘, 纷乱

whirred.translation: v. 呼呼声( whirr的过去式和过去分词 )

whirring.definition: s. like the sound of rapidly vibrating wings
whirring.translation: v. 呼呼作声地飞（或转）, 作呼呼声( whir的现在分词 ); 使呼呼地飞（或转）, 呼地一声把…带走; 呼呼声( whirr的现在分词 )
